acceptanceCriteria: Default first screen shows only the Governance Loop (Human Authority / Contract / Runtime / Repository+Protocol / Outcome) with the core sentence (agents execute, evidence determines verification, humans determine authorization) -- no simultaneous 3-panel dashboard, no permanently-shown status legend, no 9-step lifecycle dump on first load.

The 3D scene renders explicit relationships: Contract, Evidence, and Outcome exist as scene objects; directional flow/arrows connect Agents->Entry->Runtime->Repository and Repository->Evidence->Runtime->Outcome->Human Authority; core elements have persistent 3D labels.

A guided narrative ('Understand AI Cockpit in 30 seconds') runs the 7 scenes described (autonomous execution stopped at the gate, Contract, repository facts, execution/checkpoint, evidence, verification GREEN with the 'Verified != Approved' beat, human decision PENDING/APPROVE/REJECT) rather than a plain camera pan across objects.

Navigation exposes exactly three modes -- Overview, Work Item, Verification -- and the Work Item mode shows the inspect..close lifecycle as a horizontal timeline (not nine dashboard tiles), selecting a step filters the 3D scene to that step's relationships.
Verification mode moves the camera into the Runtime and shows Tests/Contract/Snapshot feeding GREEN, then explicitly shows Human Decision PENDING as a separate, disconnected-by-default state.

Detail Panel for any selected element shows WHAT / INPUTS / OUTPUTS / BOUNDARY sections instead of prose; upstream revision/provenance moves to a secondary About/Source location, not the primary interaction path.

Existing infrastructure is preserved: Next.js App Router + static export, React Three Fiber/Three.js/drei, Tailwind, the src/data/* semantic model and upstream provenance boundary, the design-system tokens (modified/extended, not deleted), docs/upstream.md, and the ai-cockpit .ai/ governance files.
npm ci, lint, typecheck, unit tests, Playwright e2e, and production static-export build all succeed; keyboard-only navigation still works without requiring 3D interaction.
goal: Ship v0.2: a restrained default scene (no simultaneous 3-panel dashboard), a 3D scene graph with explicit relationships/flows/arrows/labels (not just objects), a 7-scene guided narrative culminating in 'Verified != Approved', three page modes (Overview / Work Item / Verification), and a redesigned Detail Panel (WHAT/INPUTS/OUTPUTS/BOUNDARY). Keep Next.js/R3F/design-system/data-layer/.ai infrastructure; rewrite ExplorerShell, ArchitectureScene, architecture/*, interaction/tour.ts, GuidedTour.tsx, lifecycle/*, and integrate verification into the 3D scene.
intent: Rewrite the Explorer's experience layer from an 'architecture stack of objects' into a 'Governance Loop' that visually explains Contract -> Runtime -> Evidence -> Outcome -> Human Authority as a process, not a set of shapes.
